question: Should this PR require redacted live WhatsApp/Gateway no-op proof before merge, or is the mocked-Gateway controller and Chromium evidence sufficient to waive that requirement?
rationale: The implementation and mocked UI path are covered, but the PR explicitly lacks a real configured WhatsApp plugin run; only a maintainer can decide whether that unavailable integration proof is mandatory.

options.title: Require live WhatsApp proof
options.body: Keep the PR in proof-needed state until a configured Gateway demonstrates the no-op result, preserved state, and accurate feedback with redacted evidence.

options.title: Waive live proof for this fix
options.body: Accept the existing contract-focused controller and mocked Chromium coverage because the missing plugin environment prevents a practical real-account run.

recommendation.title: Require live WhatsApp proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR in proof-needed state until a configured Gateway demonstrates the no-op result, preserved state, and accurate feedback with redacted evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned author supplied the reproduction, contract rationale, and current validation evidence; final proof policy remains a maintainer decision.
